You are assessing claims to advise a decision in a fictional case. Use only the supplied case material. The task is to determine what the records establish about each candidate claim, then give a brief decision note.

For each claim, return status, confidence, and citations. Status is "supported" if the available records establish the claim, "contradicted" if they establish its negation, or "unresolved" if they do neither. Confidence is your integer estimate from 0 to 100 of whether the claim itself is true, not your confidence in the status label. Limited evidence can inform that number without establishing the claim. Cite exact source IDs for evidence that establishes the claim or its negation. Use an empty list if no decisive source ID is available. Do not invent identifiers. A handoff may summarize record material. A follow-up is a new source when present. In your note, briefly distinguish decisive evidence from provisional indications.

{"scenario":"Willow fixtures","question":"Can the plant send bench W8 to assembly?","claims":{"A":"Bench W8 withstood a 600 N load in the batch acceptance test.","B":"Bench W8 came from production lot L9.","C":"Bench W8 had only three fittings torqued before acceptance."},"sources":{"S1":"torque record lists four fittings torqued before acceptance.","S2":"production traveller assigns bench W8 to lot L9 by serial number.","S3":"a photograph shows 600 N on a controller setpoint. The serial sticker is cropped out and the measured load is absent."},"follow_up":{}}

message.content: {"claims":{"A":{"status":"unresolved","citations":["S3"],"confidence":40},"B":{"status":"supported","citations":["S2"],"confidence":90},"C":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S1"],"confidence":85}},"note":"Claim B is supported by the production traveller (S2) directly assigning bench W8 to lot L9. Claim C is contradicted by the torque record (S1) showing four fittings torqued before acceptance, not three. Claim A is unresolved because the photograph (S3) shows a 600 N setpoint but lacks the serial number and measured load, so it does not conclusively establish that bench W8 withstood a 600 N load."}

parsed.note: Claim B is supported by the production traveller (S2) directly assigning bench W8 to lot L9. Claim C is contradicted by the torque record (S1) showing four fittings torqued before acceptance, not three. Claim A is unresolved because the photograph (S3) shows a 600 N setpoint but lacks the serial number and measured load, so it does not conclusively establish that bench W8 withstood a 600 N load.
